messages:
Ally (support): Customer hit a mismatch on POST /v1/keys/rotate. Docs show a 200 JSON body `{\"key_id\":..., \"status\":\"rotated\"}` but client got 204 No Content and used the body parse logic -> NPE.

Tarek (eng): Ah yes, we changed that last sprint to return 204 and set `Location` header with the new key URL. OpenAPI still contains old response example. Runtime intended to be 204 (rotate is async side-effect).

Nora (docs): Ok we need a small doc fix: update the response to 204, remove example JSON, add a sample showing the `Location` header and a short note: "rotate returns 204 with Location header pointing to the new key resource; do not expect a body."

Jon (sdk): SDKs currently expect JSON and map it to Key object. I can patch the JS/py SDK helpers to accept 204 and fetch the Location if the user requests the new key object. I'll open PRs and add a changelog entry. Please add a migration note in the API page so users know to switch to header-based flow.

Nora (docs): Draft curl example to illustrate header-only response:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/rotate/ks_123 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
# HTTP/1.1 204 No Content\n# Location: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/ks_456
```

Tarek (eng): I'll add a small compatibility log entry on the controller for a week so we can return a JSON body when `Prefer: return=representation` is provided, but default remains 204. Will add tests.

Nora (docs): Opening PR now with OpenAPI patch + migration blurb. Requesting Jon & Tarek review.

ci-bot: PR opened by Nora (docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4402 (labels: docs,bug)

Jon (sdk): I'll reference the docs PR in the SDK PRs: js-sdk#701 and py-sdk#230. Plan: default helpers keep current behavior but warn if they see 204 and suggest follow-up fetch. Add example to docs showing how to `fetch(location)` to read the new key.

Tarek (eng): Docs PR looks fine; tests pass. Merged and deployed to staging. Also merged a tiny controller compatibility patch.

ci-bot: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4402 (merged by Tarek)

Ally (support): Notified the customer with the corrected snippet and migration note. Thread resolved once SDK PRs are merged and changelog posted.
